items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: he pulled me in as a back-up or a sub for Fred.

ctx.x: Let me wrap up with asking you what it’s been like to — you had a long tenure with the Harlem Blues & Jazz Band, and shared the stage with some older gentlemen. I wonder what that’s been like?

It’s been wonderful you know. I came into that band as the baby. Doc [Vollmer] came to one of the sessions, the jam sessions at the union hall and that’s where he heard me, and he liked what I was doing and he spoke with me, and he pulled me in as a back-up or a sub for Fred.
